title: A rainy alley outside the workshop
summary: The operations garage now overlooks a stormy alley and has finished workshop fittings.
notes: Add a framed window with a real alley view, wet pavement, bins, pipes and a warm service light.
Add outdoor rain, occasional lightning and quiet spatial storm ambience like the pawn shop.

Add a broom cupboard with cleaning supplies and remove floating debug-style labels throughout the garage.
